caption_L1: Here a is a bar plot named Number of billionaires worldwide from 2001 to 2012 , by region. The y-axis plots United States while the x-axis shows year.
caption_L2L3: In the first three years of the new century, the number of US billionaires fell consistently, but turned a corner in 2004. The numbers rose steadily until 2008/2009, presumably because of the world's financial crash whic would have created a substantial loss of wealth for the richest portion of society. From 2009, the numbers progressed annually, although not as quickly in the earlier years of the new century.
